title: 第12章 跟我们走一趟
novel_title: 1960：九个妹妹把我宠上天(天下第九)
content_zh: “这个主意不错。”“可以一起合伙换南瓜。”“我同意，我们合伙吧！”立即有人同意了合伙这个方案。辰楠心中暗喜，但表面上仍保持镇定：“今天带的南瓜就剩这一个。”众人听了这话有些失望，不过下一句话顿时让他们激动起来。“不过...外面我还放了不少南瓜，如果各位想要，可以跟我去搬来。”“我这里有一条中华烟，可以换一个大南瓜吗？”卖棉花的摊主激动开口，这是可以填饱肚子食物！“我要五个这样的大南瓜！”卖布料的摊主急切地说，“用一匹棉布换，怎么样？”“我要三个！”卖烟酒的也不甘示弱，“用十瓶二锅头，外加十条‘大前门’烟换！”“我用两瓶茅台换一只大南瓜可以吗？”一个摊贩弱弱开口。一瓶茅台四块钱，两瓶也就八块钱，若是算上甲级酒票的价值，价格可以再翻一番，可一个七八十斤的大南瓜价值远远不止十六块钱。由于粮食紧缺，原本两三分钱一斤的南瓜在黑市都疯涨了十几倍，如今黑市的南瓜价格是三毛两分钱一斤，若是百斤重的南瓜怎么说也得三十多块一个。而且这个价格还不是固定的，可能明天又会变成四毛钱一斤也不是没可能。只要是粮食，价格时刻都在变，有涨有跌，但大部分都是涨的多。“好说好说，”辰楠笑得哈喇子都快流出来了，今晚来对地方了，没想到连茅台跟中华烟都有，“你们跟我出去把南瓜搬进来。”很多人都出去帮忙，这一幕已经很久没发生过。很快，辰楠带人出了黑市。来到一个草丛停下，他让众人等等。他进入杂草丛生的地方，意念一动，在众人看不到的地方，十几个大南瓜出现在草丛里。“果然都在这里，刚才他们就说已经搬过来。”辰楠挥手让人过来搬南瓜，人群顿时热闹起来，没想到那么多大南瓜，个头是真大啊！一群人搬着南瓜热热闹闹地往黑市里走去。半个小时后。辰楠摊位前的人流终于变少了，而他的竹篓也装满了，地上还放着不少东西。也就是有人在不方便，否则他早就把这些东西都收进空间里放好。他清点了一番，这次换到的好东西真不少。鸡蛋就换了十斤、还有一匹（30米）浅蓝色布料（90尺）。五斤白糖，三斤红糖、二锅头十瓶、茅台五瓶、十条大前门，三条中华烟。还有一些日用品，如盐、油酱醋茶，还有一个大铁锅，都是实打实的好东西。唯一可惜的是没有换到粮食，没人拿粮食出来换东西。有人拿棒子面想要交换南瓜，但辰楠并没有答应，棒子面实在是太难吃，不是细粮他也不要。他倒是想换点种子，可没人拿出来交换。辰楠背起竹篓，身后就有个黑漆漆的胡同，他抬腿就走了进去，没一会再次出来，竹篓已经空空如也。如此三趟下来，换来的东西全部被转移到空间小世界里。这一切在别人眼里，就是辰楠把东西搬进胡同给了同伙，否则也不会那么快回来。就在辰楠准备收摊回家时，摊位前来了两个不速之客。辰楠抬头看去，只见二人并没有包裹脸面，很有可能是这里管事的，只见其中一个络腮胡大汉开口。“这位小哥，我们刀哥想见你。“其中一个汉子语气平淡，却带着不容拒绝的意味。或许是这里的动静引起了管事的注意。不过辰楠并不紧张，这种事情早有预料。以前经历过比现在更加危险的事情，这种小场面让他提不起太多的兴趣。虽然他现在身体很弱，但这些时间他一直在喝灵泉溪水，身体素质不断在增强。哪怕他现在很弱，但一人打几个成年人应该不是什么问题。“走吧。”辰楠也想看看这里管事的找他做什么。若是有交易还好说，若是想敲他一笔，那就有好戏看了。后海的胡同幽深曲折，辰楠毫不紧张地跟在两个精壮汉子身后。三人穿过几条蜿蜒的胡同，最终停在一座看似普通的四合院前。领路的汉子有节奏地敲了门，不一会，木门吱呀一声被打开。院子里青砖铺地，四周廊下挂着几盏煤油灯，将院落照得半明半暗。正房门前，一个三十多岁的男子端坐在太师椅上，左脸眼角处一道刀疤从眉骨一直延伸到颧骨，在灯光下显得格外狰狞。辰楠瞥了那刀疤男一眼，看样子他是这里管事的。刀疤男身后站着两个膀大腰圆的马仔，三双眼睛齐刷刷地落在辰楠身上。若是个寻常少年，被这般阵势一吓，怕是早已腿软。但辰楠只是平静地回视，甚至还微微勾起嘴角。他目光不经意地扫到刀疤男身旁那个格外显眼的大南瓜。就这巨型南瓜的样貌，不用想都知道正是他刚才在黑市上换出去的其中一个。“这是你的南瓜？“刀疤男抬了抬下巴对着一旁的南瓜，声音平淡得听不出情绪。“没错。”辰楠也不客气，直接在旁边的石凳上坐下。这个举动让刀疤男眼中闪过一丝讶异，一旁的伙计就要呵斥，但却被他抬手制止。他只感觉眼前这年轻人身上有股特殊的气质，虽然脸上包裹着布料看不清样貌，但那独特的气质一看就不是普通人。寻常人见到这场面早就慌了神，可这少年却镇定自若，这让刀疤男不得不重新评估眼前这少年。多一事不如少一事，还是先谈正事要紧。“这样的南瓜，你还有吗？“刀疤男开门见山，手指轻轻敲着身旁那个足有七八十斤重的大南瓜。这种巨型南瓜太难见了，几年都见不到一个如此重量的。而且刚才他用刀切了一小片南瓜尝了口，觉得味道非常的清甜可口，这是在其他南瓜身上没有的味道。如此巨物一般都不会很不好吃，可尝试一番后，并没有想象中的粗糙难吃，反而味道非常不错。
content_en: "This is a good idea." "We can work together to exchange for pumpkins." "I agree, let's work together!" Someone immediately agreed to the partnership plan.Chen Nan was secretly happy, but remained calm on the surface: "This is the only pumpkin I brought today." Everyone was a little disappointed after hearing this, but the next sentence immediately made them excited."But... I also have a lot of pumpkins outside. If you want them, you can move them with me." "I have a Chinese cigarette here. Can I exchange it for a big pumpkin?" The cotton stall owner said excitedly. This is food that can fill your stomach!"I want five of these big pumpkins!" the cloth seller said eagerly, "How about exchanging one piece of cotton cloth?" "I want three!" The cigarette and alcohol seller was not to be outdone, "I want ten bottles of Erguotou, plus ten 'Da Qianmen' cigarettes!" "Can I exchange two bottles of Maotai for one big pumpkin?" a vendor said weakly.A bottle of Maotai costs four yuan, and two bottles cost only eight yuan. If the value of the Class A liquor ticket is included, the price can be doubled, but a large pumpkin weighing 70 to 80 pounds is worth far more than sixteen yuan.Due to the shortage of food, pumpkins that originally cost two or three cents per catty have skyrocketed by more than ten times on the black market. Today, the price of pumpkins on the black market is thirty-two cents per catty. A pumpkin weighing a hundred catties costs more than thirty yuan a piece.And this price is not fixed yet, it may become 40 cents per pound tomorrow. It is not impossible.As long as it's food, prices are changing all the time, some rising and some falling, but most of them rise by a lot."It's easy to talk," Chen Nan laughed so hard that he almost cried out. He came to the right place tonight. Unexpectedly, there were even Maotai and Zhonghua Cigarettes. "You guys come out with me to move the pumpkins in." Many people went out to help. This scene has not happened for a long time.Soon, Chen Nan led people out of the black market.When he came to a bush and stopped, he asked everyone to wait.He entered a place overgrown with weeds, and with a thought, a dozen large pumpkins appeared in the grass where no one could see them."Sure enough, they are all here. They just said they have moved here." Chen Nan waved people over to move the pumpkins, and the crowd suddenly became lively. I didn't expect so many big pumpkins, they are really big!A group of people carried pumpkins and walked lively to the black market.Half an hour later.The flow of people in front of Chen Nan's stall finally decreased, and his bamboo basket was full, with a lot of things on the ground.That is to say, it was inconvenient for someone, otherwise he would have put all these things into the space and put them away.He took inventory and found that he got a lot of good things this time.The eggs were exchanged for ten kilograms and a piece (30 meters) of light blue cloth (90 feet).Five kilograms of white sugar, three kilograms of brown sugar, ten bottles of Erguotou, five bottles of Maotai, ten Daqianmen, and three Chinese cigarettes.There are also some daily necessities, such as salt, oil, soy, vinegar, tea, and a large iron pot, which are all real good things.The only pity is that no food was obtained in exchange, and no one exchanged the food for anything.Someone wanted to exchange the stick noodles for pumpkin, but Chen Nan didn't agree. The stick noodles were too unpalatable, and he didn't want them if they weren't refined grains.He wanted to exchange some seeds, but no one offered them in exchange.Chen Nan picked up the bamboo basket, and there was a dark alley behind him. He raised his legs and walked in. After a while, he came out again, and the bamboo basket was empty.After three trips like this, all the things exchanged were transferred to the small world of space.In the eyes of others, all this was just Chen Nan moving the things into the alley and giving them to his accomplices, otherwise he would not have come back so quickly.Just when Chen Nan was about to close the stall and go home, two uninvited guests came to the stall.Chen Nan looked up and saw that the two men did not cover their faces. They were probably the ones in charge here. One of them, a bearded man, spoke."This little brother, Brother Dao wants to see you." One of the men said in a calm tone, but with a meaning that could not be refused.Perhaps it was the movement here that caught the steward's attention.But Chen Nan was not nervous, this kind of thing had been expected for a long time.He had experienced more dangerous things before, so this small scene did not interest him much.Although he is very weak now, he has been drinking water from the Lingquan stream these days, and his physical fitness is constantly improving.Even though he is weak now, it shouldn't be a problem for one person to fight several adults."Let's go." Chen Nan also wanted to see what the people in charge here wanted to do with him.If there is a deal, it's easy to say. If you want to make a deal with him, then there will be a good show.The alleys of Houhai are deep and winding, and Chen Nan followed the two strong men without any nervousness.The three of them walked through several winding alleys and finally stopped in front of a seemingly ordinary courtyard house.The man leading the way knocked on the door rhythmically, and after a while, the wooden door opened with a creak.The courtyard was paved with green bricks, and several kerosene lamps were hung on the surrounding corridors, illuminating the courtyard in half-light and half-darkness.In front of the main door, a man in his thirties sat on the Taishi chair. A scar stretched from the corner of his eye on the left side of his face from his eyebrow bone to his cheekbone, which looked particularly hideous under the light.Chen Nan glanced at the scarred man and it seemed that he was in charge here.Behind the scarred man stood two tall, round-waisted men, and three pairs of eyes fell on Chen Nan.If he were an ordinary young man, his legs would have been weak if he was frightened by such a formation.But Chen Nan just looked back calmly, and even raised the corners of his mouth slightly.His eyes inadvertently glanced at the particularly conspicuous big pumpkin next to the scarred man.Judging from the appearance of this giant pumpkin, it didn't take much to figure out that it was one of the ones he had just traded for on the black market."Is this your pumpkin?" The scarred man raised his chin and faced the pumpkin beside him, his voice was so calm that no emotion could be heard."That's right." Chen Nan was not polite and sat down directly on the stone bench next to him.This move caused a flash of surprise in the scarred man's eyes. The waiter on the side was about to scold him, but he raised his hand to stop him.He just felt that the young man in front of him had a special temperament. Although his face was wrapped in cloth and his appearance could not be seen clearly, his unique temperament showed that he was not an ordinary person.Ordinary people would have panicked when seeing this scene, but this young man was calm and composed, which made the scarred man have to re-evaluate the young man in front of him.It is better to do less than to do more. It is better to talk about the business first."Do you still have a pumpkin like this?" The scarred man got straight to the point, tapping the big pumpkin next to him that weighed seventy or eighty kilograms.This kind of giant pumpkin is so rare that one of this weight has not been seen for several years.And just now he cut a small piece of pumpkin with a knife and tasted it. He felt that the taste was very sweet and delicious, which was a taste that was not found in other pumpkins.Such a huge thing is usually not very unpalatable, but after trying it, it is not as rough and unpalatable as expected, but tastes very good.
